method: Google Trends comparison plus live search-result intent review; no Keyword Planner search-volume access.

google_trends.note: 0–100 indices share this comparison scale; these are not monthly search counts or ranking-difficulty scores. Broad queries have mixed intent.

qualified_query.note: Zero on this scale is insufficient evidence of no demand; rounding and sparse search data prevent a useful volume conclusion.

intent_evidence.observation: The product category uses reading ruler for following a text line; this supports terminology, not volume or efficacy.
Google explains normalization and low-volume zero values.

decision: Use reading ruler for Chrome to qualify the homepage. Publish three distinct scenario articles rather than repeat generic product FAQs. Choose by product fit and clear intent, not the largest broad index.
